rationale: Personal/organization-scoped publication is described as unlinked by default; connection shows repository information such as README and can enable inherited access. Preserve the explicit workflow auto-link exception reviewed in issue 269 rather than making the default universal. Personal and organization linking flows select a package through the respective profile Packages tab and confirm Connect repository. Navigation and confirmation instructions are not permission or successful link receipts; no connection changed. The inheritance include applies in pinned FPT/GHEC scope and can grant linked workflow access unless organization automatic inheritance is disabled. GHES Container Registry remains preview with Packages/subdomain-isolation prerequisites; no state observed. CLI linking adds an image.source Dockerfile label containing the repository URL with OWNER/REPO and a deployment-specific repository host. This source metadata is not independently verified ownership, rights or actual native link. The GHES example prose names github.companyname.com but the source-label example renders containers.github.companyname.com via a registry-host include. Retain this source-versus-registry hostname mismatch instead of copying it as a verified repository URL. The build example assumes current-directory Dockerfile and image name; image-list inspection is optional. The later illustrative tag ID differs from the listed built image ID. Examples are not an executed or internally validated artifact chain. Tagging/pushing selects registry host, namespace, image name and tag; authentication uses illustrative environment-token stdin login. Login success text and image IDs are not receipts; no secrets, builds, tags or pushes performed. Unlinking removes repository information and may affect access depending on inherited permissions; the note excludes Apache Maven from this behavior. Do not model unlink as access-neutral metadata-only change or universal registry operation. An absent Repository source section indicates no link in this UI flow. A present source section without trash icon may reflect packaged source metadata, not an actual GitHub repository link. File metadata and section existence therefore do not independently prove connection. Unlinking uses the source-section trash icon and requires confirmation. Linking to another repository is described as unlink then relink; this may alter access and does not authorize changes, demonstrate recovery or guarantee uninterrupted consumers. GHEC managed-user publication remains organization-only through the product include. External Docker/OCI and access guides remain outbound references, not reviewed by mention; independent semantic/published audit and rights acceptance remain open. Full source read with previously inspected required include/feature/variable dependencies. No policy adoption or native validation.
